title: Impact of Frailty and ICU-AW on Post-ICU Fatigue Self-reported
official: Impact of Frailty and ICU-AW on Post-ICU Fatigue Self-reported
summary: After a prolonged stay in Intensive Care Unit (ICU), fatigue is the most common symptom reported by patients in the Post Intensive Care Syndrome (PICS). Other complications have been described, including ICU-acquired weakness, leading to increased morbidity and mortality after discharge. Actually, risk factors associated with post-ICU fatigue self-reported are not really known.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with a length of stay in intensive care \> or equal to 7 days, or mechanical ventilation \> or equal to 5 days

Exclusion Criteria:

* Scheduled surgery with admission in ICU
* Pregnancy
* Guardianship
